summary: Retune kernel selections with schema 22 across all built-in components
details: The selection-cache envelope and every built-in query and config schema use version 22, so autotuned startup measures eligible configurations again and subsequent startups reuse those decisions.
Earlier cache files remain intact. Explicit B12X_TUNING_CACHE_VERSION values and configuration overrides retain their existing meaning.
Package source changes produce distinct compiled artifact identities, so startup can require kernel compilation as well as retuning.
